param.description: A name/value pair the user can disable without deleting it.

requestId.description: Opaque id the caller chooses, so http.cancel can abort this exchange.

url.description: Absolute, with scheme and host. Any existing query string is preserved.

headers.description: Connection, Content-Length, Expect, Host and Upgrade are owned by the client and ignored here.

redirects.description: normal follows redirects but not from HTTPS down to HTTP.

verifyTls.description: False disables certificate and hostname checks, for self-signed development servers.

maxBodyBytes.description: Bodies past this are counted but not buffered.

variables.description: Resolved values for {{name}} placeholders in the url, query, headers and body. An unknown name is left exactly as written.

auth.description: How to authenticate the request. Values may contain {{variable}} placeholders, so secrets are resolved by the shell and never written to a collection file.

token.description: bearer: the token, literally or as a placeholder.

key.description: api-key: header or query parameter name.

tokenUrl.description: oauth2: where the token is exchanged.

authUrl.description: oauth2 authorization code: where the browser is sent.

redirectUri.description: oauth2 authorization code: loopback redirect; the core defaults it.

accessToken.description: Resolved by the shell from safeStorage for oauth2-authorization-code; never written to a file.

refreshToken.description: Resolved by the shell; lets an expired access token be refreshed.

expiresAtMillis.description: When the resolved access token expires, epoch millis.

content.description: The literal payload for json and raw.

contentType.description: Overrides the type implied by the body mode. An explicit Content-Type header wins over both.

headers.description: Sorted by name. A header sent more than once appears more than once.

content.description: Decoded text, or null when the payload is not textual.

base64.description: The kept payload bytes as base64, for non-textual bodies. Null for textual bodies. Images and other binaries use this to preview and to save.

bytes.description: Total bytes received, whether or not they were kept.

dnsMs.description: Host resolution, measured immediately before dispatch. Null when resolution failed or the host was an address.

downloadMs.description: Headers until the body is fully read.

redirects.description: Hops followed, oldest first. Empty when nothing was followed.

cancelled.description: True when a request was in flight under this id and has been asked to stop.
